rationale: Two SSNs written with no separator must both be redacted, leaving no digits behind.
phileas currently matches only the fragment [4,14) that straddles the pair and emits '123-{{{REDACTED-ssn}}}-45-6789', so real SSN digits survive redaction. See philterd/phileas#343.
Separating the same two values with a space or comma works, so this is specific to unseparated values.
